notes: The power plug now watches for a key stuck on. While a piece plays, the tablet reads the 24 V supply's power from the plug every couple of seconds and compares it with the keys the music is holding: a steady extra draw of about one key (a key left on, for example after a lost message to a key board) stops the piece and switches the 24 V off within about 20 seconds ("A key stayed on — 24 V cut"). After every piece it checks that the draw falls back to idle and that the piano reports no key on and no new communication errors; if not, "A key stayed on after the piece — 24 V cut". Either way the safety check runs before the next piece. At power-up, more than 30 W with nothing playing is cut at once. It needs the power plug; with Full power off, only the check after the piece runs.
